newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to seek support at 4,750-4,770.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to seek support at 4,750-4,770.

text.p: The FTSE 100 may seek support at 4,750-4,770 on Monday as falls in Asian markets cause further weakness to UK shares, technical analysts said.
The FTSE had made good progress until late last week by gaining over 950 points or 23 percent up to August 12, but that easy sailing has come to an end following last Friday's 125 point tumble.

In the past, sharp falls in the stock market have quickly found buyers to prop it up again, but it will not be so easy this around because of fears of interest rises in the U.S. and Germany this week.
A technical rally may appear as a result of some bargain hunting and as traders take profits from short positions but this may take the FTSE no higher than 4,930.
But steering a course to high ground again will be difficult because short-term momentum remains weak and calculations from the FTSE's 10-day momentum implies a fall to 4,750 is possible this week.
By 0727 GMT, the FTSE was indicated down 57.8 at 4,808.0. The Hang Seng index closed 400.83 points down at 16,096.88 on Monday. In New York, on Friday, the Dow closed down 247.37 to 7,694.66.
